concerns.text: T014a (Detect outcome type) is listed as a prerequisite for T021b-ValidateDesign and T021b-GenerateConfig, but T014a is marked [P] (parallel) and placed AFTER T013 (Clean data). However, T013 depends on T012c-FlagAmbiguity, which depends on T012b, which depends on T012a. T012a loads raw data. The dependency chain T012a -> T012b -> T012c -> T013 -> T014a is correct for data flow, BUT T014a is marked [P] (parallel-safe) while it reads `data/processed/cleaned_data.csv` which is the output of T013. If T013 is not complete, T014a cannot run. The [P] tag on T014a is incorrect as it has a hard dependency on T013 completion.

T021b-ValidateDesign and T021b-GenerateConfig share the same ID 'T021b'. This creates an ambiguous dependency graph. T021a depends on 'T021b-GenerateConfig', but T021b-ValidateDesign is a distinct logical step that must run before T021b-GenerateConfig. The duplicate ID breaks the deterministic ordering check and makes the 'Producer before Consumer' rule impossible to verify programmatically.

T021a (fit_adaptive_model) depends on T021b-GenerateConfig. T021b-GenerateConfig depends on T021b-ValidateDesign and T014c-FlagAmbiguousType. T014c depends on T014a. T014a depends on T013. T013 depends on T012c. T012c depends on T012b. T012b depends on T012a. T012a depends on T010d. T010d depends on T010b. T010b depends on T000h. This chain is valid. HOWEVER, T022 (VIF) is listed as [P] but depends on T021a (model fit) which is not marked as a dependency. T022 must run AFTER T021a, not in parallel.

T023 (Extract coefficients) depends on T021a (model fit). T023b-SimulationValidation depends on T023. T023c-ValidateCIWidth depends on T023. T024 (Fallback logic) is listed as [P] but logically must be part of T021a or T023 execution flow, not a parallel task. If T024 is a separate script, it must run after T021a to apply fallbacks, or be integrated into T021a. As a separate [P] task, it implies it can run before T021a, which is impossible.

T030 (Sensitivity analysis) depends on T023 (Model output). T031 (Post-hoc) depends on T023. T031b-ValidateStability depends on T031. T032 (Forest plot) depends on T030. T033 (Report) depends on T035 (Schema) and T030/T031. T035 (Schema) is marked [P] and must run before T033. This is correct. However, T032b (Template) is marked [P] and must run before T033. T032 (Plot) is marked [P] and must run before T033. The dependency T033 -> T032 is missing in the text description of T033, though implied by 'forest plot'. Explicit dependency 'Must run after T032' is required for T033.

T000d, T000e, T000f, T000c, T000g, T000h are all marked [P] (parallel). However, the text explicitly states 'Must run after' dependencies between them (e.g., T000e after T000d, T000f after T000e). The [P] tag is semantically incorrect for tasks with hard sequential dependencies. They should be untagged or the dependencies must be removed (which would break the logic).
